brief:
Hundreds of Palestine Action campaigners plan to gather at the US embassy in London on Halloween in defiance of the group's proscription order, Al Jazeera English reported. The demonstration is scheduled before a Supreme Court hearing where the organization will challenge the UK government's decision to label it a terrorist group.

Palestine Action has faced legal restrictions following the ban, which the group contests as unjustified. The protest will take place as the group prepares to argue its case in the high court proceedings on the classification.
dek: Campaigners plan mass Halloween action before Supreme Court hearing on challenge to group's 'terrorist' proscription.
title: Activists plan mass protest at US embassy before court challenge to ban
